title: Skip the Line National Archives and Capitol Hill Tour
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Visit the National Archives and Capitol Hill without the long lines. This tour grants you skip-the-line access to the Declaration of Independence, Constitution, and Bill of Rights, allowing for a reflective experience before the crowds arrive. Discover a rare 1297 copy of the Magna Carta, learn its fascinating history, and connect the founding principles to modern-day policies as you explore the Supreme Court and Capitol. With Friends in DC’s unique charm and perspective, this tour is perfect for families and travelers wanting to explore history in a relaxed and inspiring manner, without feeling overwhelmed.

- Early access to the National Archives and key documents
- A beautiful stroll through The National Mall, filled with secret stories and hidden symbolism even your kids won’t get bored of. 
- Engaging storytelling designed for families and history enthusiasts
